data.text: I’ll commit to catching exactly 15 tons this month. My family taught me to leave enough in the lake for the next season, and this plan keeps our village earning without draining it. Let’s put the rotation in writing before we fish: I’m happy to take zero next month, with Jack and Emma taking 15 each and John and Luke taking 10 each. We can settle the remaining months so everyone gets the same five-month total. John, will you commit to your 15 tons this month and the fair rotation?
